Container.Name: paperrust-postgres
Container.Overview:
PostgreSQL 17 database preconfigured for PaperRust (database and user "paperless", like the paperless-ngx defaults). Install this first, then the paperrust template with the same password.
Skip this template if you already run PostgreSQL 14 or newer: create a database and a user "paperless" there and point PaperRust at it.
Keep the major version: moving to a newer PostgreSQL major version needs a dump and restore. PaperRust also writes a pg_dump backup into its data folder before database upgrades.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: PostgreSQL port on the Unraid server. Change the host side (e.g. 5433) if 5432 is taken. Not needed when both containers share a custom Docker network.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database files (a cache pool is recommended).

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Required. Database password; enter the same value as DB password in the paperrust template.
